meta._comment: Emerald obtainability override for the base-non-wild ('unknown') species. Keyed by National Dex number. Applied only for the Emerald ROM. Wild + evolution species are handled by the derivable classifier and are NOT listed here. Compiled + fact-checked against the BPEE0 ROM encounter tables and Bulbapedia (see 11-LIVINGDEX-DESIGN.md Phase 41-research).

_ingame_trades.note: Skitty is wild; and the required Meowth is itself unobtainable in Emerald.

252.name: Treecko
252.note: Starter — pick at Route 101 (Prof. Birch's bag). The other two starters are trade-only per save. Bot: Starters mode.

255.name: Torchic
255.note: Starter — pick at Route 101. Bot: Starters mode.

258.name: Mudkip
258.note: Starter — pick at Route 101. Bot: Starters mode.

351.name: Castform
351.note: Gift at the Weather Institute (Route 119) after clearing Team Aqua/Magma. Bot: Static Gift Resets.

345.name: Lileep
345.note: Revived from the Root Fossil (Devon Corp, Rustboro). Root vs Claw Fossil is a one-per-game choice at Mirage Tower — the other needs a 2nd playthrough or trade. Bot: Static Gift Resets (Hoenn Fossils).

347.name: Anorith
347.note: Revived from the Claw Fossil (Devon Corp). See Lileep — only one fossil per playthrough. Bot: Static Gift Resets (Hoenn Fossils).

374.name: Beldum
374.note: Gift in Steven's house, Mossdeep, after becoming Champion. Bot: Static Gift Resets.

185.name: Sudowoodo
185.note: Route 111 — blocks the path; interact with the Wailmer Pail. NOTE: not in the bot's static_soft_resets seed (a gap to add).

377.name: Regirock
377.note: Desert Ruins, after the Sealed Chamber puzzle (Braille/Relicanth+Wailord). Bot: Static Soft Resets seed.

378.name: Regice
378.note: Island Cave, after the Sealed Chamber puzzle. Bot: Static Soft Resets seed.

379.name: Registeel
379.note: Ancient Tomb, after the Sealed Chamber puzzle. Bot: Static Soft Resets seed.

382.name: Kyogre
382.note: Marine Cave (appears post-game via the roaming weather). Emerald-specific — BOTH Kyogre and Groudon are catchable, unlike R/S. Bot: Static Soft Resets handles 'Groudon/Kyogre'.

383.name: Groudon
383.note: Terra Cave (post-game roaming weather). Emerald-specific. Bot: Static Soft Resets.

384.name: Rayquaza
384.note: Sky Pillar top. Bot: Static Soft Resets seed.

381.name: Latios
381.note: Southern Island — requires the EON TICKET (event-distribution item). Which of Latias/Latios sits here vs roams depends on the post-Championship TV answer; convention here: Latios=Southern Island, Latias=roamer. Per save only ONE Eon Pokemon is obtainable without the Eon Ticket.

380.name: Latias
380.note: Roams Hoenn after the post-Championship TV question. Convention here: Latias roams, Latios sits on Southern Island. get_roamer() reads the live species. Catchable in normal play (no event item needed).

151.name: Mew
151.note: Event distribution only (Old Sea Map -> Faraway Island). No standard in-game route in Emerald.

251.name: Celebi
251.note: Event distribution only. No in-game route in Emerald.

385.name: Jirachi
385.note: Event distribution only (Pokemon Colosseum Bonus Disc). No in-game route.

386.name: Deoxys
386.note: Birth Island via the AURORA TICKET (event item). Bot static-reset can catch it, but ONLY once the area is unlocked. In the bot's static_soft_resets seed.

249.name: Lugia
249.note: Navel Rock via the MYSTIC TICKET (event item). In the bot's static_soft_resets seed, but the area needs the ticket.

250.name: Ho-Oh
250.note: Navel Rock via the MYSTIC TICKET (event item). NOT in the bot's Emerald static seed (a gap).

172.name: Pichu

174.name: Igglybuff

298.name: Azurill
298.note: Breed Marill/Azumarill holding a Sea Incense (Sea Incense at Mt. Pyre). Marill is wild. Emerald-alone obtainable; no auto-breeder.

349.name: Feebas
349.note: Fish (any rod) on the 6 random Feebas tiles of Route 119. Not in gWildMonHeaders; tiles shift with the Dewford trend seed. Emerald-alone obtainable but not a normal encounter table.
